title: French National Observatory of Patients With Thymic Epithelial Tumor
brief_summary: RYTHMIC (Réseau tumeurs THYMiques et Cancer) is a French nationwide network for TET with the objective of territorial coverage by regional expert centers and systematic discussion of patients management at national tumor board.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patient with Thymic Epithelial Tumors

Exclusion Criteria:

* histology other than Thymic Epithelial Tumors
